result.stdout:
usage: sharpportico generate <openapi.yaml|json> [--out DIR|FILE] [--service-name NAME] [--namespace NS] [--format text|json]

  --out DIR|FILE      write the .proto descriptor (a directory gets <spec>.proto)
  --service-name NAME base name of the generated service ('Service' is appended when absent)
  --namespace NS      namespace of the generated C# (defaults to the service name)
  --format text|json  'text' (default) prints the summary; 'json' prints one document
